generation.chatgpt_note: Paste ONLY prompt_for_image_ai below. No attachments required. Fresh chat.
generation.negative_prompt: crayon, pencil texture, no outlines, chibi, second person, letter S, text, speech bubble, legs, feet, hips, waist crop line, floor line, ground line, horizontal black bar, sticker frame, border, cropped edges, tight zoom, photorealistic

prompt_for_image_ai:
Square 640×640 flat vector illustration. ONE young Filipino woman — The Guardian.

ART STYLE (describe exactly):
- Clean 2D vector, unDraw / corporate edu style
- Every shape has thin black outline (~2px), color hex #2D2D2D
- Solid flat fills only — no crayon, no pencil, no paper grain, no 3D, no gradients
- Face: two small black dot eyes, simple curved smile, no detailed nose
- Realistic young-adult proportions — NOT chibi, NOT big-head cartoon

BACKGROUND:
- Warm cream paper color #FDFCF8 filling entire square
- Soft lavender #9575CD blob/wash behind shoulders (~20% opacity)
- Optional 2–3 faint grey hollow circles, very light
- NO text, NO letter S, NO frame, NO border

COMPOSITION — MOST IMPORTANT:
- Bust portrait only: draw head + shoulders + upper chest + cardigan — STOP at mid-torso/ribcage
- Do NOT draw waist, hips, belt, or anything below the ribcage
- Character is SMALL and centered — figure uses only ~55% of image width and ~60% of image height
- Leave at least 25% empty cream space below the lowest part of the cardigan
- Leave ~10% empty cream above the hair
- NO hard horizontal line at the bottom — NO floor, NO ground, NO shadow stripe, NO sticker cut line
- Entire figure floats on plain cream with soft padding on all four sides

CHARACTER:
- Medium brown skin, dark hair in a low puff bun
- Lavender open cardigan #9575CD over a white top
- Warm friendly expression

POSE & PROPS:
- Right hand: open palm welcome gesture at chest height
- Left arm: slim grey clipboard held against upper chest — show plain back of board, NOT a checklist page
- Small teal heart icon floating near the open hand (no speech bubble)

REJECT IF: bottom is cut off, floor line appears, character touches image edge, or style looks hand-drawn/crayon.
